text:
Hi there, and thanks so much for contacting Leafy! 🌿

Great question. Unfortunately, only **one promo code** can be used per order, so two codes can't be stacked together.

A few other things that might help:

- **Adding a code later:** Promo codes can't be added after an order has been placed, so be sure to enter your code at checkout.
- **Leafy Plus members:** A promo code can't be combined with Leafy Plus member pricing on the same item. If both apply, the better discount is applied automatically, so you don't need to do anything.

If you have two codes, I'd suggest trying the one that gives you the bigger saving at checkout.

Is there anything else I can help with? We're always happy to help, so please reach out any time. Happy planting! 🌱
